video_title: NBA Draft Preview 👀 Best options for Clippers, Mavs & Thunder | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's contract situation and the Clippers' future
quotes.excerpt: It's got to be the future of Kawhi entering the last year of his contract
quotes.quote: It's got to be the future of Kawhi entering the last year of his contract on an expiring deal, extension eligible for two years, over $100 million. The Clippers have gone youth with the recent trades. How does he fit in for the future?

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Keaton Wagler's size and fit alongside Darius Garland
quotes.excerpt: Why would you like Keaton Wagler? Because of his size to pair up next to Darius Garland

text_blocks.speaker: Sean Farnham
text_blocks.text: You can look at a player like Keaton Wagler and why would you like Keaton Wagler? Because of his size to pair up next to Darius Garland who is a smaller guard at 6'6. He has the upside, he showed the great ability this year at Illinois, can be coached hard like he was for Brad Underwood.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc Spears
text_blocks.text: I'm hearing from one NBA GM he expects them to go five or six.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Mikel Brown Jr.'s high ceiling and injury concerns
quotes.excerpt: Mikel Brown Jr. has maybe the highest ceiling of anybody you're going to find
quotes.quote: The name I want to focus on is Mikel Brown Jr. This was a young man a year ago that was as highly thought after as any player in the country, but then missed more games than Darren Peterson. As long as you can justify the back injuries and you check those all out, when you watch him play, he has that pro game with unlimited range. 30 plus feet, catch, shoot, off the bounce doesn't matter, he can drain it. Mikel Brown Jr. has maybe the highest ceiling of anybody you're going to find at the number five slot.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Brayden Burries' versatility and fit for the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: Brayden Burries can also impact the game at the defensive end of the floor
quotes.quote: Brayden Burries is an older freshman, he's 21 years old, so he's not your typical freshman coming into this NBA draft, but his versatility and how he performed over the course of season reminds me of Derek White. If you've got Kyrie Irving and Cooper Flagg, what you need is somebody to come in that can be a lower usage player, but yet still be efficient and help you win games. Brayden Burries can also impact the game at the defensive end of the floor. I love this pick if the Mavs have him on their board and he's available when they're on the clock.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: Morez Johnson Jr.'s strength and potential for the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: Morez Johnson Jr. has the prototypical ability to add strength underneath
quotes.quote: Sam Presti was sitting just a couple seats away. His eyes were locked in on this guy, Morez Johnson Jr. They're talking about great size that has the prototypical ability to add strength underneath. And if you look at the Western Conference, you look at this team, adding more strength and look at the verticality there. Almost silly. But what he did maybe more than anybody expected was his ability to stretch the floor. A lot of people hadn't seen his ability to shoot, but when you look at what he can bring to the table, he's a championship pedigree, an older experienced player. And again, some of these teams, like a team like OKC, they're in a win now mode, so can you find somebody here that is not necessarily a project, that is going to fill the role and support the stars that you already have in house?

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Darryn Peterson's draft status and Utah's evaluation process
quotes.excerpt: Darryn Peterson believes he's a top player in the draft, he has not visited any other teams
quotes.quote: Darryn Peterson believes he's a top player in the draft, he has not visited any other teams. There is some concern about his agency, which also represents Keyonte George, about their fit together. The organization does not share the concerns about that fit. Having said all that, if Dybantsa is the number one player overall, there's no guarantee that the Jazz draft Darryn Peterson. They are continuing their evaluation. Cam Boozer is very much in play, his dad Carlos is part of the scouting staff there in Utah.

quotes.speaker: Tim MacMahon
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler's contract negotiations and trade value
quotes.excerpt: The Jazz have put it all on the table for five years and roughly $140 million
quotes.quote: The Jazz have put it all on the table for five years and roughly $140 million. Walker Kessler's representation believes his value is significantly higher than that. There were discussions with the Indiana Pacers before they traded for Zubac about trading for Kessler, giving up two first-round picks, and signing him to a deal that would have been north of that. The Jazz have also been very firm. They want a five-year deal. They want a five-year commitment. Kessler is a restricted free agent, the Jazz would have the right to match any offer that he received in restricted free agency, but they're using that leverage.

quotes.speaker: Sean Farnham
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Dybantsa as the projected number one overall pick
quotes.excerpt: I think AJ Dybantsa is going to be the number one overall pick in this draft
quotes.quote: I think AJ Dybantsa is going to be the number one overall pick in this draft and I think it's been trending that way since before the combine. I think it's going to continue to trend that way. I do think there's a scenario where Boozer goes number two because he's an 82-game guy. You know exactly what you're going to get out of him. He's got great versatility, unbelievable motor can stretch the floor, plays with such great composure and a great rebounding presence as well, which Utah could certainly use.
